video_title: I Tried the VIRAL Chick-fil-A Chicken & Waffles… Is It Actually Good? 👀

quotes.speaker: Isaac Core
quotes.summary_phrase: The mental toll of bad games on player performance
quotes.excerpt: You feel the pressure on you. You see the negativity going on online, Twitter, Instagram, whatever.
quotes.quote: Say you have been having a couple bad games in a row, probably about three, four in a row. You feel the pressure on you. You see the negativity going on online, Twitter, Instagram, whatever. People are saying you are trash, this and that. And then your next game, you wake up, you have a good feeling. You get on the court and you drop 40. 4-0, you drop 40 points. That is what this tastes like.

quotes.speaker: Isaac Core
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the Chick-fil-A chicken and waffles to a 40-point game
quotes.excerpt: It feels like I went to the moon and back.

text_blocks.speaker: Isaac Core
text_blocks.text: So, I got the spicy chicken sandwich. I mean, chicken and waffles. Let's see how this goes. You try it without the syrup first and then with it. Try it without it and then with it.

text_blocks.speaker: Unnamed Friend
text_blocks.text: It feels like I went to the moon and back. Jesus. Oh my god. It feels amazing.
